summary:
Engage with peers to explore actionable insights and practical frameworks for enhancing your organization's digital literacy and AI consciousness. This discussion will focus on both successes and challenges, with the ultimate goal of optimizing the benefits of these technologies while preparing for future challenges.

Hosted by Mercedes Pantoja at Siemens Healthineers, come together with peers to discuss:

Differentiating AI technologies and their implications
Establishing safety guardrails for technology access
Cultivating a digital mindset across the organization

Join these Peer Meetups, powered by Gartner CDAO Communities, for a networking session that allows you to connect and share with a small group of your peers facilitated by a CDAO Community Member. Please make every effort to attend as other attendees will be looking forward to meeting with you.
